title: Grimmer Steel
description: Do you want to bring diversity to your world? Do you want to become efficient without spending hours in the mines? Then you're at Grimmer Steel! Here, in the first hours of the game, you will receive a sky set of instruments and will be able to play by you
body:
Do you want powerful tools *without* 10 hours of grinding?  
Do you want to shape your world — not just survive it?

**Grimmer Steel** is here.

⛏️ In the first 20 minutes: craft the **Sky Pickaxe** (10M durability).  
🐉 In the first hour: upgrade to the **Dragon Set** — at the crafting table.  
✨ Before lunch: wield the **Absolute Sword** — and one-shot *anything*.

No cheats. No waiting. Just smart design:
- Amethyst is actually useful (4 shards ⇄ 1 block),
- Bone blocks → bones, instantly (thanks to the Bone Hammer),
- Every upgrade is fair — and *fast*.

If you believe:  
> *“Why dig for days… when you can build a legend in one?”*  

— then welcome home.

🔧 Forge | 🎮 1.19.2 | 📦 No dependencies  
**Install. Play. Create miracles.**
